text_block_list.text:
On the way back to the academy,
something
catches Грасс Вандер's
attention.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look't these... They're all so
pretty!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Spe! What's that you're looking at?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Oh—hi, Grass! And... hello, Trainer! How
are you
this evening?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I was just looking at the kimonos over in
that
shop window! Look, aren't they
pretty?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're gorgeous... and all made
from a
high-end hemp fabric, it seems.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
A what?  Y-you must know a lot about
clothes!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hehe. I dabble a little, is all.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Aw, I'm jealous. I bet you're used to
wearing
kimonos like these, huh?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I only got to wear one for Shichi-Go-San
when I
was little. My mom got it for me.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Actually, that makes me envious of you,
Spe. I
never got to celebrate
Shichi-Go-San when I was
growing up.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, that's right. You were in
America,
weren't you?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Yes. Out of everyone I knew, I was the
only one
with my own kimono.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, I wished I could dress up
together
with girls my age.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Without losing her usual smile, Grass
Wonder
gazes distantly into the shop
window.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Why don't you two dress up now, then?
How about we hold a race in kimonos?

text_block_list.text: Now as in... right now?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look at the sign, Grass! It says we
can try
them on!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Hehe. So that's what you were referring to.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
So you... don't mind if we take this small
detour?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Hehe. Now, which to put
on... ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Goodness. Hehe. That sounds like a
blast.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Wha—?! But I, uh... I don't know how to
put it on!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
There's no need to fret, Spe. I'll help
you out. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
And of course, you'll be joining us as
well,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
By all means. One of these days, we
should go
kimono shopping for you as
well.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I wonder what design would suit
you
best. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер tries on kimonos with
Special
Week, looking as happy as can
be.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер appears to have
thoroughly
enjoyed herself today.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
